description: This file defines GDB pretty printers for debugging, including classes for various data structures and a registration function for GDB integration.

classes.name: PrinterSetup
classes.description: Holds configuration for a GDB pretty printer, including name, regex pattern, and printer class.

classes.name: StaticVectorPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for static_vector<T, N> data structure.

classes.name: BFloat16ComplexPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::cbf16_t complex type.

classes.name: StrongTypePrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::strong_type<...> and derived types.

classes.name: StrongTypeLookup
classes.description: Lookup class to identify types inheriting from ocudu::strong_type<...>.

methods.name: register_printers
methods.description: Registers all defined pretty printers with GDB for the given object file or gdb.
